message.content:
Emerald green sheath dress, fitted bodice with a slight A-line skirt that hits mid-calf, #056b3c color, velvet fabric with a subtle satin lining to contrast the warm skin tones of #d9b48f and #d1ab86.
Silver stiletto pumps, pointed toe with a sleek silhouette, #c0c0c0 metallic finish, smooth patent leather that reflects the festive lights without being too glossy.
A structured black blazer, single-breasted with notched lapels and sharp shoulders to elongate the frame, #000000 solid color, heavy wool blend that provides necessary warmth against the frosty autumn weather.
This outfit works because the emerald velvet captures the celebratory mood of the New Year's party while adhering strictly to her refusal of outer layers when not truly needed, though here a blazer is chosen for the specific frosty condition rather than just warmth alone; the fitted silhouette complements her measurements without relying on body-type labels or numerical limits, creating a refined yet comfortable look suitable for an upscale restaurant; the silver shoes add a touch of sparkle that bridges the gap between smart and formal dress codes without overshadowing the rich color of the dress.
